title: Hitting lists for noncommutative rational formulas
exact_target: Can polynomial bit time in unary n,s produce a polynomial-size list of rational matrix n-tuples such that every nonzero admissible size-s free rational formula has a defined evaluation with invertible value at some list member, uniformly over arbitrary rational constants and inverse depth, without receiving the formula?
